instruction: I am formatting an essay document with three paragraphs. Please set the font size to 10pt for the first paragraph (introduction), 14pt for the second paragraph (body), and 16pt for the third paragraph (conclusion).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);
